## Beyond the brief: trust and on-demand use
**Prepare Evidence Check → AI Evidence Check** sends all six sections and the listing data to the shared `AI Evidence Check` workflow. Its verdict (pass / review / block) appears as a Trust box at the top of the report (**Add Trust Box**) and in `agent_runs.trust_verdict`.
**Report Row → Save Report** keeps the HTML in `reports`; **Run Summary** is the short answer returned to chat or to the Slack `/rug-intel` command (**When Called by Another Workflow**).
